note: THE DOCUMENT DOES NOT SAY WHICH PARTICLE WAS BOUGHT. It is a product-family sheet: the Particles/mg and Particles/ml tables run from 0.05 um to 3000 um, sixty diameters, and every diameter-dependent quantity is a column rather than a value. So this source alone answers nothing about the tracers actually in use, and the open question it creates -- which diameter, which lot -- is the one thing blocking tracer_number_density and tracer_diffusivity for the caller who asked for both today. Recorded as the gap tracer_diameter_unknown, which only a person can close.
not_entered: Three things in this document are deliberately left out. (1) The centrifugation-parameter table on page 3 is sample-preparation procedure, not knowledge about the sample, and no seat here has asked for it. (2) 'Strong resistance to photobleaching' and 'high fluorescence intensity' on page 3 are unquantified marketing prose; the microscope seat asked for bleaching_rate today and got absent, and it stays absent, because a number that is not printed cannot be inferred from an adjective. (3) The refractive index is NOT in this document. Polystyrene has a well-known value but this sheet does not state it, so it is not entered from here -- the gap refractive_index stays open and is now findable rather than merely absent, because the material is established.
